cells.gaps: No adoption of the Lettre de politique sectorielle is on record: the final validation workshop was reported on 2025-02-10 and a July 2026 document still describes it as validated. No source holds its text, a delivery plan, a report against it, a mandated body or a budget line, and no dated event falls inside the twelve months to the as-at.
cells.note: Lettre de politique sectorielle 2025-2029: validated and not adopted, with its 2025-2029 period still running, which is stage 2. Stage 3 needs it adopted and its text public, and neither is on record.
